correctness.rationale: The exact simplicial decomposition of wheel matchings into rim-only simplices and disjoint spoke cones induces an equivariant relative-chain direct sum. Integral path/cycle homotopy and the contractible-link inclusions yield the three residue-specific long exact sequences and free groups. Reflection path reversal gives (-1)^{k(k-1)/2}; signed fixed-simplex counts supply every dihedral character. Reproduced signed character comparisons for every dihedral element of wheel sizes 3..18 (672 wheel and rim checks), and independent mod-2 chain ranks for sizes 3..10. The general proof does not rely on extrapolation from finite tests.

value.rationale: The wheel family is a natural infinite family of planar graphs. Rotation/reflection actions on nonzero homology are invisible to sphere multiplicities; the theorem gives all characters and an exact integral group-module augmentation/induction sequence. It directly distinguishes the two reflection classes and provides useful symmetry-sensitive structure without claiming an integral split not proved.
